name: Zum Tiroler
kurzbeschreibung: Pub in the Wilten district of Innsbruck on Adamgasse, close to the city centre, with indoor seating.
beschreibung: Zum Tiroler is a pub in the Wilten district of Innsbruck. The establishment is located on Adamgasse, just a few steps from Bozner Platz and therefore close to Innsbruck's city centre. As a classic pub, it invites you to enjoy drinks and socialise. The premises have indoor seating; there is no outdoor dining area. It is open Monday to Friday from 9:30 to 22:00 and on Saturday and Sunday from 10:30 to 22:00. The establishment is not accessible for people with disabilities. Further details about the kitchen, the food or a dedicated website could not be verified through official sources.
